item.title: Catherine O'Hara, star of 'Home Alone' and 'Schitt's Creek,' dies at 71
item.description: Renowned actress Catherine O'Hara has died at the age of 71, according to multiple reports.

item.title: Volunteers needed for Miller Park Zoo Stampede fundraiser
item.description: The Miller Park Zoological Society is looking for volunteers to help with its upcoming Miller Park Zoo Stampede fundraiser on March 7, which includes a 5k run, 3k walk, and kids 1/4 mile fun run, to raise money for new exhibits and animal care.

item.title: Coroner releases identity of man who died in El Paso wreck
item.description: Steven Porter, 37, of Bloomington, died after his car hit the rear of a semi on I-39 near mile marker 14.

item.title: Illinois Music Education Conference to stay in Peoria through 2031
item.description: The Illinois Music Education Conference has signed a new five year contract to remain in Peoria through 2031, guaranteeing a major economic boost for the region and further positioning Peoria as a destination capable of hosting large scale statewide conventions.

item.title: Recruitment surges at Bloomington Fire Department after shift change
item.description: The Bloomington Fire Department has seen an increase in recruitment due to a change in shift schedule, resulting in more EMT-certified applicants and allowing the department to backfill positions as many are close to retiring.

item.title: Bloomington police officer retires after 20 years of service
item.description: Officer Nik Jones, a 20-year veteran of the Bloomington Police Department, is retiring after serving in a variety of roles, including as a crisis negotiator, active shooter instructor, and school resource officer, as well as his dedication to the Special Olympics and SOAR program.

item.title: Normal Fire Station Two relocates despite community and union concerns
item.description: Normal Fire Station Two has officially moved to its new building on the east side of town, despite pushback from Local 2442 about the move increasing response times for high risk community members, and the Town Council is divided on whether to hold a work session to discuss the issue.

item.title: Living to Serve aids incarcerated women with resources
item.description: The Living to Serve Foundation held an event at the Peoria County Sheriff's Department to help incarcerated women learn about their future healthcare and post-sentence situations, with over 20 vendors and speakers providing resources and support.

item.title: Former Peoria County prosecutor pleads guilty to weapons charge
item.description: Kali Pray, a former Peoria County assistant state's attorney, pleaded guilty to a felony weapons charge and was sentenced to two years of probation and 300 hours of community service.

item.title: Ken Burns guest curates America 250 exhibit at Peoria Riverfront Museum
item.description: The Peoria Riverfront Museum is set to unveil the "Promise of Liberty" exhibit, featuring 250 of the most important historical documents in the country, including the Declaration of Independence, Martin Luther King Jr.'s "I Have a Dream" speech, and the Emancipation Proclamation.
